scope: Simulates all 18 family members (put mode x trigger x channel) and keeps those consistent with calibration receipts; resolves a goal only when all consistent members agree.
lesson: The channel is changes() (last direct row-change count), not cumulative total_changes, and the put mode is INSERT OR REPLACE with no trigger: repeated puts on the same key each count 1, and rollback discards pending writes while the counter still reflects the rolled-back statement.
